method_note: ICCAS 2025 (Incheon, Nov 4-7, 2025) PaperCept program; the 2026 edition (Sapporo, Oct 27-30, 2026) has not yet taken place. Counted 57 topical oral sessions (306 papers), grouping numbered series (e.g. "Control Theory and Applications 1-4"). Excluded: 2 Award Sessions, Koh Young AI Competition, 2 poster sessions (169 papers, untitled), 3 Frontiers sessions, tutorials, workshop, plenaries. Mixed-content sessions ("Robotic Applications", SICE-ICROS "Robot Technology", "Navigation, Guidance and Control") were mapped after reading their paper titles. Each session split equally across at most 2 keywords; weight = sessions mapped / 55. 2 session(s) had no taxonomy equivalent and were left out of the denominator: Information and Networking Systems; Development of Next-Generation Robot Common Platform Technology for SDR Transformation. Keywords below 0.02 omitted; listed weights sum to 0.872. deployable-structures: none found in the 57 counted ICCAS 2025 oral sessions; the matching papers (Leg-And-Wheel Transformable Mechanism Using Origami Cylinders; Geometric Analysis of Workspace in Tensegrity Prisms; 3-DOF Module with Parallel Foldable Joint) are all in the excluded poster session FrPO.
